profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.jobTitle: Software Developer for IBM Hyper Protect Crypto Services
profile.summary: Experienced engineer with over a decade of polyglot experience, ranging from creating scripts to creating and managing entire platforms. Enjoys working with, and quickly learns, new technologies.

positions.title: Software Developer for IBM Hyper Protect Crypto Services
Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Single handedly designed, directed, and maintained a cloud platform, and all related services, to generate medical diagnostic reports for a functional medicine protocol to prevent, reverse, and potentially cure Alzheimer's disease.

•	Exponentially increased monthly recurring revenue more than 800% in less than one year
•	Revamped barely functioning platform into a platform on track to make over one million in its first year of production use
•	Directly worked with the CEO and Board of Directors to influence technical decisions, on track to becoming CTO

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Directly hired to work on MPI Cognition's cloud platform that was started by a former Factivate engineer, while also working on Factivate's main spreadsheet product.

•	Drastically reduced time taken to create an object in spreadsheet ribbon bar by at least 50%
•	Auspiciously hired by MPI Cognition to work on their platform full time

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Closely worked in a distributed agile environment to develop an automated email campaign SaaS, reporting directly to the Vice President of Product.

•	Swung the door open for remote development, scoring extremely talented engineers
•	Successfully created first Go microservice in the platform that manages millions of email templates
•	Collaboratively designed, implemented, maintained, and documented SaaS features, services, and AWS infrastructure

projects.title: async
projects.description: I am the owner and maintainer for this package. It is a module for providing simplistic asynchronous routines in Go.

projects.title: lexer
projects.description: I am the owner and maintainer of this package. It is based on my UTF-16 scanner package and currently parses languages that were required for Sourcegraph.
